metadata.title: One gradient step
metadata.subject: Mathematics / optimization
metadata.objective: See that a step moves opposite the gradient at the current point.
metadata.learner: Understands basic algebra; new to calculus
misconceptions: A big learning rate is always better
expectedUnderstanding: The step uses the slope at the current point

checkpoints.title: Predict first
checkpoints.body: Which direction should the point move when the slope is positive?

narration.text: The slope at the current point tells us which way the function rises.
We move the opposite way; the learning rate scales the step.

fallback.text: A point on a curve with an arrow pointing opposite the positive slope. A larger learning rate lengthens the arrow.

accessibility.alt: A point on a parabola and a red arrow showing a gradient-descent step
